Decluttered

Privacy Policy

Last updated 18 August 2026

The short version

Decluttered does not collect, transmit or store any personal information. There is no account, no sign-in, no analytics and no advertising. Your taste profile never leaves your device.

What stays on your device

Everything you do in the app is written to your device's local storage and nowhere else:

  • the cravings you've set up, and the genres and favourites you picked
  • every item you've saved, marked as consumed, passed on, or rated
  • your taste profile, which is derived from those actions
  • your daily streak, goals, and city preferences (Table only)

We cannot see any of it. It is not backed up to a server we control, and it is not synchronised between devices. Deleting the app deletes it. You can also erase a craving's data from inside the app, in Profile → Start over.

What leaves your device

The app has no backend of its own. It does request content directly from third-party services in order to show you things:

ServiceWhat is requestedWhy
DeezerA track's preview URLThe 30-second audio preview
YouTubeAn embedded trailer playerFilm and show trailers
Wikimedia / WikipediaImages and article textPhotos and critical reception
Open Library, IMDb, TVMaze, TMDBCover art and metadataCard artwork and details

These requests contain only what is needed to fetch the content — for example a track ID or an image address. They do not include any identifier we created for you, because we do not create one. However, like any request to any website, these services will see your IP address and can apply their own privacy policies. YouTube's embedded player in particular may set its own cookies. If that matters to you, avoid opening trailers.

We do not share, sell or transfer anything to anyone, because we do not have anything to share.

Children

The app is not directed at children. Its catalogues include films and shows rated for mature audiences, which is why it carries a 12+ age rating.

Changes

If this policy changes, the updated version will be published here with a new date.

Contact

Questions about privacy: open an issue at github.com/hhwolf/asterialogs or contact the developer through GitHub (hhwolf).
